title: Surreal Dreamscape Collage
description: A six-panel collage of distinct painted scenes. Top row shows a serene pond with lily pads, a cosmic black hole vortex with swirling rings and celestial bodies, and a stylized green abstract face with swirling patterns and multiple eyes. Bottom row displays a dark castle under a blood-red stormy sky with lightning, and a vibrant green lakeside landscape with blue water and yellow wildflowers.
prompt: A six-panel collage of surreal painted scenes, top left a tranquil blue pond with green reeds and lily pads, top center a cosmic black hole vortex with swirling white rings and floating celestial bodies against a starry sky, top right an abstract green stylized face with swirling patterns and multiple expressive eyes, bottom left a gothic castle by water under a dramatic red stormy sky with lightning, bottom right a peaceful lakeside meadow with vibrant green grass, blue reflective water and yellow wildflowers, painterly style with visible brushstrokes
